data.name: Acenaphthene with Seawater
measurement_methods: A 100 mL-aliquot was extracted three times with n-hexane. The concentrated hexane extract was analyzed by a gas chromatograph equipped with a flame ionization detector to determine the hydrocarbon concentration.
mixing_methods: Saturated solutions was prepared by equilibrating seawater with an excess of hydrocarbon for 24 hrs in a constant temperature gyrotary shaker followed by 12 hr stationary period.

publication_references.citation: Rossi, S.S.; Thomas, W.H., Environ. Sci. Technol. 1981, 15, 715-6.
